evidence.quote: I got yesterday some more & enough specimens of Helix pomatia
which my Boys study with great interest

reference_observations.description: Lyell note supplies discovery news; no complete source body in current incoming catalogue.

evidence.quote: I had a note from Lyell this morning

reference_observations.description: Note available in Glasgow, pamphlet merely presumed at Down, no reading proved.

evidence.quote: Your most kind note has been forwarded to me here, but not your pamphlet.

reference_observations.description: Oral exchange took place, pigeons ordered but two ducks brought home; tooth measurement still requested.

evidence.quote: ordered some pigeons & brought home two curious Ducks

reference_observations.description: Acknowledges dispatch and answered questions while hoping safe arrival.

evidence.quote: sending me the canines, & which I hope will arrive safely

reference_observations.description: Own Indian wild fowl head/skeleton offered for loan. Does not establish exact specimen arrival or reading of Blyth 1746.

evidence.quote: Would you like to examine the head of my wild Jungle Fowl from India?
